deliveryAreas.title: Where we deliver
deliveryAreas.intro: By hand from the studio in Digbeth. Each area has its own cut-off for same-day delivery. Forever bouquets are posted anywhere in the UK.

how.a: We do, in our own car. Never a courier for fresh flowers.
We ring the number you give us. With your say-so we leave them with a neighbour; otherwise we bring them back and try again the same day.

how.q: Can you deliver at a set time?
how.a: We deliver between 11am and 7pm. For a set time, message us first and we'll say honestly whether we can.
Boxed and posted by Royal Mail Tracked 48 the next working day, anywhere in the UK, for £6.

care.title: Your flowers
care.intro: Two minutes now keeps them for a week.
steps: Cut each stem at an angle, about two centimetres, with clean scissors.
Fill a clean vase with cool water and the flower food in the sachet.
Take off any leaves that would sit under the water.
Keep them away from radiators, sunny windowsills and the fruit bowl.
Change the water and trim the stems every two days.
care.lasts: Fresh bouquets last about a week, peonies a little less. Forever bouquets need no water: keep them out of direct sun and away from damp.

questions.a: Yes, in our Birmingham areas, if you order by 2pm Tuesday to Thursday, 4pm on Friday or noon on Saturday. The line above the bouquets says how long is left.
£8 in our areas (£10 to Harborne). Forever bouquets are posted anywhere in the UK for £6.
Message us your order. We reply to confirm and send a secure payment link.

questions.q: Can you make something I saw on TikTok?
questions.a: Usually, yes. Send us the link with your budget and the day, and we'll tell you what we can do with what we have in.

questions.q: Can I choose the wrap colour?
questions.a: Yes: blush, ivory, white or sage tissue, and satin ribbon to match. Tell us in your message.

questions.q: What are forever bouquets made of?
questions.a: Satin flowers we make by hand, preserved roses, and dried flowers. Each one says which in its message to you.
Satin flowers don't fade. Preserved and dried flowers last months, longer out of direct sun.
The studio is small and we're often out delivering, so collection is by arrangement. Message us a time.
